scope: Design guidance and source-derived behavior only; runtime values vary per generated project. No production project contract or live runtime provided.

rules.backendAuthority: Project-pinned generated contract + runtime policy; never infer it from Blueprints
rules.otherAuthority: Separate Other backend catalog, semantic bindings and own runtime contract
rules.disposition: No row complete unless source, exported decision, runtime effect, UX, error, tests and E2E proven

decisions.behavior: Web HttpOnly cookie, Flutter Bearer+Secure Storage; one Backend, separate client transport
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: credential mechanism, secure token lifecycle, cookie/CSRF rules if any

decisions.behavior: guided/command produce same validated generator; preset is a starting point
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: no Fable generator dependency; own configuration schema

decisions.behavior: single or multi-profile; User remains authentication identity not domain profile
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: user-vs-profile separation, profile types/relations

decisions.behavior: standard/single-person-account/limited-person-accounts/unlimited-person-accounts; device/IP not person proof
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: account linking/verified identifiers and limits if supported

decisions.behavior: owned by personal User, role membership, owner immutable, OTP on sensitive lifecycle, delete recovery and onDelete=Restrict
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: subaccounts/owner/member/invite/step-up/version/recovery policy

decisions.behavior: build-time session hints; GET /auth/session-policy runtime authority, single/multi/overflow
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: runtime session policy, device list/limits/revocation semantics

decisions.behavior: enabled providers, OTP policy/channel, verified contact, no username OTP
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: provider choices/MFA/OTP challenge, verification and recovery contract

decisions.behavior: Accept-Language validated; X-Time-Zone untrusted hint; after auth session timezone authority
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: locale/timezone header semantics, authoritative server timestamp

decisions.behavior: X-Request-Id and traceparent optional validated observability only
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: correlation ID and redaction conventions

decisions.behavior: Idempotency-Key validated 8..128, sensitive retryable mutation only
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: idempotency scope/expiry/replay/error and safe retry rules

decisions.behavior: If-Match optimistic concurrency when supported by operation
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: ETag/revision/412 or 409 and conflict merge rules

decisions.behavior: native Flutter does not send Web-only CSRF; Origin not Auth; trusted proxy controls forwarded headers
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: CORS/CSRF boundary and allowed header policy

decisions.behavior: validation rules/fields; 400 invalid key, abuse/rate limits, 401/403/404/429, retry signals
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: stable error code, fields, rate limits and retry/denial semantics

decisions.behavior: DB source of truth; cached reads must invalidate after mutations; sensitive outputs no shared cache
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: TTL, ETag/version, invalidation and private/no-store response behavior

decisions.behavior: explicit block-delete/cascade/detach/retain/anonymize; legal retention; Restrict on managed domains
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: delete/recovery/retention/export/tombstones policy

decisions.behavior: installed capability from a pinned project only, not global Blueprint inventory
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: signed/versioned per-project operation inventory and feature availability

decisions.behavior: runtime authorization/entitlement authoritative; no roles from client guesses
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: /me permissions/entitlements, revocation/events, billing state

decisions.behavior: local feature decision; never imply safe offline writes without version/idempotency
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: delta/sync/revision/idempotent mutations and price confirmation

decisions.behavior: source/IP untrusted; HMAC fingerprints for abuse, no secrets/raw IP in logs
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: 429 responses, retry-after, security alerts, secure audit IDs

decisions.behavior: optional minimum/supported app version, no fake mandatory update endpoints
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: compatible version check, upgrades and safe-link metadata

decisions.behavior: overload/rate/maintenance may deny requests; do not show success from failures
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: transient 503/429/Retry-After and bounded recovery

decisions.behavior: runtime permissions not local admin flag, user role distinct from profile/managed entity
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: verified operation permissions and role changes

decisions.behavior: @ProtectedAuth, @SensitiveFilterSort and onDelete affect filtering/field visibility, not decoration
decisions.otherBackendRequirement: Other: per-field read/write grants, masked fields and relation deletion behavior
